items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: somehow Schribman wanted Billie Holiday to come with us to see how it worked out with Artie Shaw... Sy Schribman had the idea that Billie should come on as a single... And Billie would come on as a single and perform her bit.

ctx.x: He was at that New England bandstand where all the musicians played.
